details.purpose: Both forms define one recognizable interior rather than two unrelated ornaments

details.deletion_test: Removing either form opens and unbalances the common interior

realized_detail_0.instructions: Does the actual candidate visibly realize the contribution of detail_plan.details[0] (Complementary chamber contours) at its declared scale?

criteria.true: The visible geometry, proportion, assembly or material response supports the planned contribution. Hero-only detail can resolve in native views without appearing in a favicon.
criteria.false: The contribution exists only in the explanation, is absent, or is undermined by unresolved construction in the actual pixels.

detail_developed.instructions: Does the candidate visibly develop purposeful construction or material detail beyond the prior baseline?

criteria.true: More resolved proportions, junctions, seating, edge hierarchy or credible material detail develop the new direction. A higher ornament count is not required.
criteria.false: Only gloss, texture density or a more flattering explanation changes; the visible construction remains underdeveloped.

obligation_realized.instructions: Do the actual candidate pixels fulfill the particular correction in authoring_obligation.claim?

criteria.true: Visible construction or material evidence addresses the stated correction at its relevant scale, rather than only realizing an unrelated self-selected detail plan.
criteria.false: The specific correction remains visibly unfulfilled, even if other planned details are present.
